title: LifeSpace provider-neutral External Adapter request v1

x-lifespace-response.authentication: fixed private Service Binding + independent shared Secret
x-lifespace-response.ownership: LifeSpace Core; provider adapters consume contract version 1

x-lifespace-record-identity.shape: rec_external_<stable-resource-namespace>_<stable-local-identity>; do not expose raw Provider-local IDs as LifeSpace record IDs
x-lifespace-record-identity.namespace: Adapter MUST derive a durable, collision-resistant namespace from the Provider resource identity and its Provider identity (providerKey + stable resource ID), or use an existing Provider globally unique resource UUID namespace (Notion V1 compatibility). A display name, Space name or mutable connection/token is not a namespace.
x-lifespace-record-identity.stability: A Provider record retains its exact public LifeSpace recordId across reads, queries, updates, connection credential rotation, disable/re-enable, and binding/schema refresh. Different Provider resources (including different Providers) must never emit the same LifeSpace recordId for different records.
x-lifespace-record-identity.ownership: Core owns one global recordId namespace: once observed, (recordId, Space, External binding) ownership is immutable. A conflicting Adapter result fails closed at the D1 commit boundary. No silent UPSERT success, cross-binding reparenting or fallback to provider-local IDs.
x-lifespace-record-identity.compatibility: Previously issued rec_external_<notionDataSourceUUID>_<notionPageUUID> IDs remain stable. Existing Notion IDs are NOT rewritten or remapped by this clarification.
